added.summary: The CSS box model. width and height take auto, min-content, max-content and fit-content(<length>), and the logical inline-size and block-size map to them. min-/max- bounds (and their logical forms) take lengths, percentages, math functions and content sizes on any size, and a bound alone no longer turns a block into a fit-content box. aspect-ratio takes a / b and auto, box-sizing takes content-box (border-box stays the default), and padding takes its longhands and the logical padding-block and padding-inline.
